LightningComponentBundle.description: The console shell: background, top bar, footer, theme and URL routing. Hosts the hub and every card inside one page.

property.name: brandLabel
property.label: Brand label
property.description: Shown next to the logo in the top bar.

property.name: accentColor
property.label: Accent colour
property.description: Drives --gold. Restrained platinum-grey by default rather than a literal gold.

property.name: startScreen
property.label: Start screen
property.description: home or login. Internal users are already authenticated, so home is the usual choice.

property.name: backgroundImage
property.label: Background image URL
property.description: Leave blank to use the Modon hero render.

property.name: userName
property.label: Fallback name
property.description: Only used until the running user's real name resolves.
